raster_review.scope: independent editorial species-specific raster review; original source and 64px thumbnails; not botanical certification

anatomy.description: Foglia composta trifogliata di fragolina: tre foglioline dentate su picciolo comune; nervature schematiche, nessuna scala o pelosità dedotta.

parts.label: Picciolo e raccordi
parts.meaning: Picciolo comune e brevi raccordi visibili alle tre foglioline.

parts.label: Fogliolina terminale
parts.meaning: Una delle tre foglioline; lamina, dentatura e nervature visibili nel raster.

parts.label: Fogliolina sinistra
parts.meaning: Fogliolina laterale sinistra, con dentatura e venature già disegnate.

parts.label: Fogliolina destra
parts.meaning: Fogliolina laterale destra, senza ricostruzione di superfici nascoste.

anatomy.annotation_method: Manual anatomical region drawing on exact cropped raster; boolean intersections of visible paints, no automatic taxonomic interpretation.
limitations: Part visibility is inspection only, not a new biological specimen.
Material tint is a technical illustration demo, not an approved biological color variant.
No hidden tissue is reconstructed; moving a part can expose a transparent gap.

author: Fronda/Fungaroli
geometry: Source paint stacks intersected into actual anatomical part geometries; no raster, masks, clips or complete-object copies. Graphic underpaint retained inside each part to preserve antialiasing, not reconstructed hidden tissue.
unsupported: quantitative organ counts from illustrative marks
